caveats: Baltic MHW detection per published catalogue method: baseline years 1992-2002; the per-day-of-year pool uses all SST values within +/-5 calendar days of each baseline date, so data from 1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05 were also used (hence baseline_analysed span). Thresholds are the 90th percentile of the pool using MATLAB-default quantile (numpy method='hazen', Hyndman-Fan type 5), ignoring NaN; day 60 (29 Feb) set to the mean of days 59 and 61; both threshold and climatology then smoothed with a wrapping 31-day centred moving mean. 296 of 3600 regional grid cells had non-finite SST on at least one target day and were treated as land (mhw=0); 3304 sea cells were analysed. Per-cell MHWs are runs of >=5 consecutive days with SST >= threshold, merged when separated by 1-2 non-hot days (gap days included). One regional event detected: 2004-08-05 to 2004-08-15.
